mapper.select: SELECT oc.order_id, gc.card_groups_id, gc.card_group_name, gc.image_url, g.gift_cards_id, g.gift_card_sn, g.card_number, g.card_password, g.expired_time, g.status, s.shop_title, s.shop_logo, gc.shop_id, gc.image_url FROM gift_card_order oc JOIN gift_cards g ON oc.card_id = g.gift_cards_id JOIN gift_card_groups gc ON g.card_groups_id = gc.card_groups_id LEFT JOIN shop s ON gc.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE oc.order_id = #{orderId}
